slides.main: Dubstep was born in a church basement.
slides.sub: The moment it left, it became something else.

text: Someone cut the UK Garage beat in half.
slides.sub: A new room opened below the floor.
There were no words for this yet.

text: Made music no one heard at night.
slides.sub: That music was Dubstep before anyone called it that.
The room that gave Dubstep its name and its home.

quote: But I recognise what he did
slides.note: Rusko: 'Brostep is partly my fault. I hate it now.' The genre watched itself split in two.

slides.cta: Save this. The next sound is already somewhere — in a quiet room.
